page_title: HEI 2-2 WER | Heidenheim v Werder Bremen 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' A cross from a corner kick by Heidenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+4' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
90+4' The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
90+1' A player from Heidenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
88' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is about to take a corner kick.

88' That's unlucky! Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Heidenheim earn a corner.
86' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
83' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header inside the right post.
83' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
80' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Heidenheim.
79' Substitution. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Budu Zivzivadze walks off.
79' Here is a change. Adrian Beck is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Julian Niehues (Heidenheim).
79' Substitution. Niklas Dorsch is replaced by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim).

78' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the target, but Diant Ramaj keeps the ball out.
78' A player from Heidenheim pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
76' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

76' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.

74' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Mio Backhaus pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.

69' 1 - 2 Romano Schmid is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 1:2.
68' Horst Steffen has decided to substitute Patrice Covic and he is replaced by Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Cameron Puertas as he is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).

67' 1 - 1 Goal! Marnon Busch shows great vision to find Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
66' Wow, what an escape. Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
63' Horst Steffen decides to make a substitution. Samuel Mbangula will be replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
63' Substitution. Jan Schoppner makes his way off the pitch and Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) comes on as his replacement.
63' Chance! Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
62' A quickly taken corner by Heidenheim.
60' PENALTY APPEAL after Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
59' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle and it's Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
57' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
56' Heidenheim are ruled offside.

56' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Mio Backhaus, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
54' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
54' One of the players from Heidenheim times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
53' The ball goes behind for a corner. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' 0 - 1 Romano Schmid feeds the ball through to Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
48' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
47' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
46' A precise low pass is received by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Patrick Ittrich has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Patrick Ittrich and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
39' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Diant Ramaj is equal to it and makes an easy save.
36' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
36' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
34' The foul by Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Patrick Ittrich.
33' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) is substituted due to injury. Frank Schmidt gives a chance to Stefan Schimmer.
32' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

31' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
30' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.

29' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Mio Backhaus is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
29' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
24' Patrick Ittrich blows the whistle, Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) is penalised for a foul.
23' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Diant Ramaj intercepts the ball.
22' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Mio Backhaus comes off his line to gather the ball.
21' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
19' A player from Werder Bremen takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
15' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
11' Patrick Ittrich shows a yellow card to Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) for a tough tackle.
8' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

7' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the crossbar. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Mio Backhaus with a fabulous save. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Heidenheim will take a corner kick.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim. Corner kick. Heidenheim will have an opportunity.
6' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
5' One of the Werder Bremen players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
3' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.

2' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom right corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Mio Backhaus made a comfortable save. Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.

The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
